raw:
@q query
  select ?where
  where match
    relation "be available"
    role subject "the new school uniform"
    role location ?where
    polarity affirmed
  end

@q2 query
  where match
    relation "be acceptable"
    role subject "the Marks and Spencer one"
    polarity affirmed
  end

@q3 query
  where match
    relation "need"
    role subject "the user's son"
    role object "the one with the badge from the school shop"
    polarity affirmed
  end
